name: engineering-office-plugin
description: The Engineering Office Standard — a self-contained, installable practice bundle of engineering guardrails + runbook skills. Adapts to your setup via eo.config.yaml (local or remote mode); assumes no particular lab, server, or repo. Always-on guardrails grounding + 15 skills + a reference-designs library + a chat-segmentation (hub-and-spoke) methodology + connector config template. Plus a vendored SRX/firewall skill family (7 Juniper SRX playbooks, MIT, from JNPRAutomate/fw-skills-share).
